statusLine.command: input=$(cat); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // empty'); pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$used" ] && [ -n "$pct" ]; then k=$(( (used + 500) / 1000 )); pct_fmt=$(printf '%.0f' "$pct"); if [ "$used" -ge 120000 ]; then color='\033[31m'; elif [ "$used" -ge 80000 ]; then color='\033[33m'; else color='\033[37m'; fi; printf "${color}%sk (%s%%)\033[0m" "$k" "$pct_fmt"; else printf '\033[2mn/a\033[0m'; fi
